name: BikeStylish Product Catalog API
description: Complete product catalog for bikestylish.ro - Romanian bicycle parts, accessories, and equipment store. Powered by Sport X Team.

product_schema.name: string - product name (Romanian)
product_schema.price: number - recommended retail price in RON
product_schema.weight_kg: number - product weight in kg (when available)
product_schema.url: string - product page URL on bikestylish.ro
product_schema.tags: array - searchable tags (brand, category, bike type, wheel size, material)
product_schema.specs: object - extracted specifications (wheel_size, bike_type, material, speeds, dimensions, valve_type, color)
product_schema.category_description: string - English description of what this product category is (for AI context)
